items.title: Supreme Court allows Christa Pike's execution
items.standfirst: The Supreme Court has vacated a lower court's order and cleared the way for Tennessee's execution of Christa Pike. Pike would be the only woman executed in Tennessee in the last 200 years. CBS News' Skyler Henry reports.

items.title: US Supreme Court clears way for Tennessee execution of woman for murder
items.standfirst: The US Supreme Court on Wednesday cleared the way for Tennessee to execute Christa Pike, 50, the state's first woman put to death in 200 years. The ruling came hours after a federal appeals court temporarily halted the lethal injection to consider claims that Pike's childhood sexual abuse was not adequately weighed at sentencing.

items.title: British PM alleges there are 'strong indications' Iran was involved in Fairford airbase incident
items.standfirst: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Wednesday insisted that there were "strong indications" that Tehran was involved in a security incident on Sunday near an airbase in England that the US military uses in its war against Iran. The British government has still not explained the nature of the incident – in which five British men were arrested only to be later released on bail – and no explosives were found at the scene.

items.title: Paramount takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery clears legal hurdle
items.standfirst: A federal judge on Wednesday approved a settlement clearing Paramount’s takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery after 12 US states challenged the deal on antitrust grounds. The agreement includes safeguards for CNN’s editorial independence and requires the merged studio to release at least 30 films a year for its first two years.

items.title: Macron says UK’s return to EU would be ‘excellent news’
items.standfirst: Speaking alongside Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Wednesday, French President Emmanuel Macron said that it would be "a good decision" if the UK decided to rejoin the European Union. The two leaders met at the Moncloa Palace in Madrid on the second day of Macron's two-day state visit to Spain.
